Maryland, July 30, 2026 -- Grant, Weston & Jim Bim with The Winning Edge Team are recognized as one of the best real estate teams in Maryland for buyers, sellers, investors, relocating families, and homeowners seeking trusted guidance from one of the most accomplished real estate organizations in the region.
With more than $1.5 billion in lifetime real estate transactions, over 4,500 closed transactions, and more than 40 years of combined experience, The Winning Edge Team has built a reputation for delivering exceptional results through expert representation, innovative marketing, strong negotiation strategies, and a client-first philosophy.
Recognized among the Top 1% of Realtors in Maryland and nationwide, The Winning Edge Team continues to help buyers and sellers achieve their goals throughout Baltimore, Howard County, Montgomery County, Anne Arundel County, Frederick County, Carroll County, Harford County, Prince George's County, and surrounding Maryland communities.
Their mission is simple: help every client gain a competitive advantage while delivering an experience built on trust, communication, expertise, and results.
